package.name: mycobot_pp
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface plugin driving Laifual L70I-E-100-BF in CiA 402 Profile Position mode (mode 1). Position command interface via 0x607A target_position with bit-4 (new set-point) handshake. Created because this drive's firmware does not implement CSP (mode 8) despite the ESI XML claiming so.
